"At the end of the report, the authors include a brief [TARGET] of their main findings for readers short on time."

Not quite. "APPENDIX" does not provide the appropriate academic register here.
Not quite. "DISCLAIMER" does not provide the appropriate academic register here.
exercises.hint: DEFINITION: A brief statement of the main points of something.
